site.title: Sign up for an Atmosphere account

embed.genericDescription: Try Atmosphere login components in a dialog, an inline form, or a full-screen flow. Configure styling, languages, and account hosts.
embed.appDescription: Start with an Atmosphere account. Choose your provider and use your account across compatible apps.

intro.title: Your account on the Atmosphere
intro.generic: The Atmosphere is a network of apps, including Bluesky, that can work with the same account.
intro.app: {{appName}} is part of the Atmosphere: a network of apps, including Bluesky, that can work with the same account.
intro.network: If you already use Bluesky or another Atmosphere app, try that account in the app you came from.
intro.hosting: Your host stores your account and app data. You will create your account on its website.
intro.reuse: Use the same handle in compatible apps. Each app asks for the access it needs.
intro.ownership: AT Protocol supports moving your account to another host. Migration tools and app support vary.

providers.title: Choose an account host
providers.intro: Your host stores your account and data. Compare its terms, region, and signup requirements. You will continue on its website.
providers.empty: This app has no account hosts available for signup.
providers.regionHint: Select regions, or leave all unchecked to show every region. A listed region is not a data residency guarantee.
providers.noMatchesHint: Try another region or clear your filters.
providers.customHint: For a host you run or one that is not listed. Use its HTTPS address.

complete.title: Your Atmosphere account is ready.
complete.handleHint: This is your handle across the Atmosphere. Use it to sign in to compatible apps with the same account.
complete.handleUnavailable: Your account is ready, but we couldn’t verify your handle right now. You can find it in your provider’s account settings.
complete.exploreHint: One account, a whole host of applications.
complete.app: You’re ready to return to {{appName}}. You will be asked to sign in separately.

errors.title: We could not complete this step
errors.unknownApp: That app is not registered. You can still create an account, but we won’t redirect you afterward.
errors.initialization: The sign-in client could not start. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unsupportedProvider: This host’s sign-in service is unavailable or unsupported. Try again or choose another host.
errors.authorization: We could not open your account host. Check your connection and try again.
errors.cancelled: Sign in was cancelled. You can try again when you are ready.
errors.callback: We could not verify the sign-in result. Start again to reconnect.
errors.providers: The provider list is unavailable. Please try again.
errors.redirect: This app’s return URL is invalid. Your account is ready, but we won’t redirect you.
errors.cleanup: Your account is ready, but we couldn’t confirm launcher credential cleanup. You can revoke the launcher’s access in your provider’s settings.
errors.identifier: Enter your full handle, such as alice.bsky.social, or an AT Protocol DID.
errors.service: Enter an HTTPS host address without a username, password, query, or fragment.
errors.provider: This account host is not available for signup in this app. Choose another host.

signin.title: Sign in to {{appName}}
signin.intro: Use your Bluesky or other Atmosphere account. You do not need a new account for each app.
signin.label: Your handle
signin.hint: For example, alice.bsky.social or your own domain. You will sign in securely with your account host.
signin.explain: Your account host opens its own sign-in page. Enter your password there and review the access this app requests. Your account stays with your host.

demo.title: Launcher Components · Atmosphere login playground
demo.heading: Login components for the Atmosphere.
demo.intro: Try the same login flow in a dialog, inside a page, or across the whole screen. Make it feel like your app.
demo.layout.dialog.hint: A login button, wherever you need it
demo.layout.inline.hint: A form that lives inside your page
demo.layout.fullscreen.hint: Space for the whole onboarding flow
demo.layout.picker.hint: Use the directory on its own
demo.hostPolicy: An explicit host list disables custom signup hosts. Existing accounts still sign in through their own host.
demo.copyFailed: Select and copy the code below
demo.es.complete: Inicio de sesión de prueba completado
demo.en.result: This was a simulation. No account was created or connected.
demo.es.result: Esto fue una simulación. No se creó ni se conectó ninguna cuenta.
demo.es.note: Demo interactiva · inicio de sesión simulado
demo.canvasIntro: An Atmosphere account works across compatible apps. Try logging in while your app stays in view.
demo.canvasFullscreen: Give new users room to understand the Atmosphere, choose an account host, and get started.
demo.pickerIntro: The standalone host picker uses the same PDS registry. Select a host to see the value your app receives.
demo.transport.popup: Open account host in a popup
demo.transportHint: Your app can use redirects or the SDK’s popup flow. This code shows the real adapter; the playground keeps sign-ins simulated.
